present есть; у меня есть = I have

examples.trans: You will be asking for forgiveness.
That is quite enough for you.

examples.text: Для настоящей любви этого вполне достаточно.
examples.trans: For true love this is quite enough.

meanings.note: usually the short form: я готов (m), я готова (f)
emphatic at the start of a sentence

examples.text: Давай мы его уволим, а тебя на его место назначим.
examples.trans: Let's fire him and put you in his place.

meanings.note: Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to do, to make', paired with 'сделать'.

examples.trans: Hi, Arkady Borisovich. What are you doing?

meanings.note: много дел = a lot to do

examples.trans: I have a lot to do.

examples.text: Мне некогда об этом думать. Слишком много дел.
examples.trans: I have no time to think about that. There's too much to do.
We could open a salon for you.

examples.text: Для вас можно открыть салон красоты.
examples.trans: We could open a beauty salon for you.

meanings.note: adds emphasis to the word before it

examples.text: У тебя же есть ещё. Дай хоть одну.
examples.trans: But you've still got some. Give me just one.

meanings.note: person harmed by a crime or accident

examples.trans: She became a victim of fraud.

examples.text: О, жертва коллекторов! Вы что-то хотели?

examples.text: Я делаю всё точно по вашему заказу.
examples.trans: I do everything exactly according to your order.

meanings.en: to deserve, merit, be worthy of

examples.text: Макс вполне заслуживает хороший урок, знаешь.
examples.trans: Max quite deserves a good lesson, you know.

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

meanings.note: emphasis: вот поэтому ты и... = that's exactly why you...

examples.trans: I was born and grew up here.

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.

examples.trans: You'll make a great mayor, Samson.

examples.text: Этого не может быть. Это наша история.
examples.trans: That can't be. It's our history.

meanings.note: нас = us (gen/acc/prep); у нас = we have, at our place

meanings.en: other forms: нас (gen/acc), нам (dat), нами (instr), нас (prep)

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates
Negative prefix 'не-' ('un-, non-, not') (stem 'много'). Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.

examples.trans: I need to do a bit of work.

examples.text: Мы даём вам ещё немного времени.
examples.trans: We are giving you a little more time.

meanings.note: + genitive: 'у нас нет выбора' = we have no choice
usually in the genitive ничего, with не: ничего не осталось

examples.text: Ну что, очкарик? Видишь, ничего не осталось.
examples.trans: Well, four-eyes? See, there's nothing left.

отомстить.gloss: to take revenge, to get back at

meanings.en: to take revenge, to avenge oneself

examples.trans: He wants to get back at his neighbour.

examples.text: Эдик, я хотела тебе изменить. С ним, чтобы отомстить.
examples.trans: Edik, I wanted to cheat on you. With him, to take revenge.

побежать.gloss: to start running, to run off

meanings.en: to break into a run, to run off
meanings.note: Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem 'бежать'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to start running, to run off', paired with 'бежать'.

examples.text: Схватил собачку в парке и побежал.
examples.trans: Grab the little dog in the park and run.
The boy quickly ran off home.

examples.text: Да это легко. Схватил собачку в парке и побежал.
examples.trans: Come on, it's easy. Grab the little dog in the park and run.

examples.text: Подожди, Нин, ты не поняла. Это же стыдно!
examples.trans: Wait, Nina, you don't get it. It's shameful!

поревновать.gloss: to be jealous for a while

meanings.en: to be jealous for a while, feel jealousy briefly

examples.trans: Let him be a bit jealous.
Fine, let Max be slightly jealous.

принять.gloss: to receive, to see (a visitor); to accept

meanings.note: Prefix 'при-' indicates approaching, attachment, or slight degree of action (stem 'нять'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to receive, to see (a visitor); to accept', paired with 'принимать'.

examples.trans: You recognised me. Thanks for seeing me.

meanings.note: takes the accusative; everyday synonym of о

examples.trans: How interesting! And in Moscow you go around saying nasty things about me.

examples.text: Мы просто не хотели вас беспокоить. Всё отменим!

examples.text: Ты преподавай. А они пусть строят свои торговые центры.
examples.trans: You teach. And let them build their shopping centres.

meanings.note: работать + instrumental = to work as: работать мэром

examples.text: Я уже четыре года работаю мэром.
examples.trans: I've been working as mayor for four years now.

meanings.note: forms the superlative: самый главный = the most important
